text: Story room read whole against story-p3: pgang, told. A room with no posts before the canvas, opened in the last half hour around a template and a territory, told by the story's opening sentence. The template comes with the first post, placement ends at hour 73 with a petition against the moderators, and the sub is offered a next job. Story room read whole against story-p3: MonkeyIsland, told. A small room's call for an easy Guybrush, one-line answers, help asked because only three were working, the work extended by LeChuck and a three-headed monkey, repairs, a move to where figures did not conflict, LeChuck given up when overrun, and Guybrush celebrated while the rest was mourned. Every step is in the story.

Story room read whole against story-p3: purplecorner, told-with-residue. A colour faction the canvas gathered, told by the story's opening sentence. Calls, upkeep, pacts and a tile traded for peace, help asked of it, coalitions against the void, calls to attack answered inside the faction, and the move to pxls.space are told. Still untold: the colour picked the rival (former blues enlisted to replace only blue tiles), the faction split over doctrine into r/purplepixels, and other rooms asked its leave to build in its corner.

The April Fools pranks run beside the work.

Story room read whole against story-p3: shield, told. A call and a plan, doubt that it would last, a first mark organized by the r/Marvelstudios Discord that members joined, an argument over its colour, defence against trolls, borders with Kamen Rider, a threat answered by yielding, a move north, the logo abandoned when help ran short and taken up again by another member, and thanks for the logo that never was. Every step is in the story.
